description.value: Sungiven Foods is a community-focused Asian supermarket chain committed to natural, less-processed foods across Metro Vancouver. The North Vancouver location on Marine Drive stocks a broad range of produce, meat, seafood, packaged goods, and dairy, alongside its own private-label brands developed to international food-safety standards. An in-store Sungiven Kitchen offers an extensive lineup of prepared dishes for cyclists who want a ready meal rather than raw ingredients.
